name: Bittensor Mining: Hardware and Software | Bittensor.ai
snippet: Bittensor mining requirements depend on the subnet’s model, scoring rules, and response-time budget. Check its current repository requirements before selecting GPU memory, CPU, RAM, and software, then compare operating costs with expected rewards.

name: Bittensor Subnet Mining 2026: Hardware, Costs, ROI
snippet: Quick Answer: Bittensor mining in 2026 means competing to serve AI workloads (inference, training, data, storage) on one of 100+ specialized subnets, earning subnet tokens convertible to TAO. Hardware ranges from a $40/month VPS for CPU subnets to $2-4/hour rented H100s for frontier text-gen subnets.

name: GitHub - douglasgalm781/sn61_RedTeam: Bittensor Subnet 61
